title: Nearest-Neighbour Matching on Unbounded Supports and Covariate Shift Transfer
summary: Expectations of multivariate functions with missing labels occur in various fields such as transfer learning and average treatment effects. Although non-parametric estimators based on nearest-neighbour matching are frequently used in this context, the existing literature assumes that the covariates live in some well-shaped compact subset of $\R^d$, with densities that are bounded away from zero. In this paper, we show that the usual rates of convergence can be achieved with minimal assumptions on the covariate supports.
